result:
I've implemented round 396 (PERF-13c-ii-b), and none of the checks I ran failed. I did not run the perf spec, any browser rows or the full suite; the task leaves those to C and the gate. The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-396.md`, with logs in `a-round-396/`.

**Changes (only the 8 granted files):**
- **Code:** I applied B's sketch patch as-is. Purchased collections now return a stable stem URL for preview, so a purchased stem preview streams instead of decoding the whole file. The stream element now sets `crossOrigin = 'anonymous'` before `src`.
- **Tests:** PV1 and PV2 are new in `collection.test.ts`. PS27–PS29 are new in `library-preview-stream.test.tsx`. PS1–PS26 are unchanged.
- **Perf harness:** a new step `a2` plus three assert rows that check the preview is playing and decodes no audio.
- **Doc 252:** status line set to `Completed (C round 396 PASS)`. Stage 3 is written in Georgian under the existing headings, with no new heading. The old "new signed URL on every call" assumption is corrected.
- **Doc 248:** only the status line changed, to `Completed (C round 392 PASS)`.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Typecheck, lint, Biome:** `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and Biome on the 4 `app/` files all exit 0. Lint shows 205 warnings across the repo; the 4 `app/` files themselves have 0.
- **Covering tests:** 19 files, 314 tests, all passing. The slowest test takes 1.7 s against a 15 s timeout.
- **Mutants:** all 7 of B's mutants fail their tests as intended, the same result as B got.
- **Claims at the end:** only the facts listed in §7 changed. The provider claim (K10) and the caller claim (K14) are unchanged.
- **File integrity:** frozen manifest 0 failures, protected files 11/11.
- **Docs:** 4 docs still say "In Progress (stage", and none say "pending".

**One change beyond B's sketch:** the code-reviewer found that PS29 would still pass if `crossOrigin` were set after `src`, which the task rules out. I made PS29 also check the attribute at the moment `src` is set. A new mutant, MU-A396-CROSSORIGIN-AFTER-SRC, fails PS29 as it should. The reviewer re-checked that change and found no Medium or higher issue.

**Notes for B:**
- The PS29 test title still says "credential-free". That isn't exactly true for same-origin demo URLs, so I corrected the wording in doc 252 but kept the sketch's title.
- Doc 248's TODO list still names PERF-13b-ii as a next step, but only its status line was granted, so I left it. Proposed id: A-R396-REVIEW-DOC248-TODO.
- Reviewer architecture note: a stable preview URL and the fallback reset both depend on the app creating one collection object per signed-URL lifetime, and nothing enforces that. This supports TL-B395-SRW21-MEMO-ADAPTER in SRW-21-PLAN.
- The other reviewer Lows (PS28's `onError(3)`, the signed URL being reachable through `previewUrl`, the perf `finally` restore) need no change now; they are in the report.

**Open:**
- **Purchased preview in a browser:** blocked, because no route uses the purchased collection until SRW-21, which the user deferred.
- **For C next:** the perf spec on its own first, then rows R8, R1b and R1–R7 at both viewports, then the AUTH, DOCS and SOURCE-SCOPE rows.

The scratch copy I used for mutants is still at `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/a396-scratch`, outside `store/`. Nothing was committed or pushed, and I have not marked PERF-13c or the backlog complete.
